facts.business: Prima Innovation Limited manufactures and sells plastic moulded products including road safety equipment, pallets, water tanks, and insulated boxes through rotational moulding, injection moulding, and blow moulding processes.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of matter regarding accounting of demerger of Rotational Moulding business from Prima Plastics Limited per NCLT order dated March 16, 2026; accounted from appointed date July 01, 2024 per Scheme and MCA Circular No. 09/2019 instead of date of transfer of control per Ind AS 103. Opinion not modified.

key_risks: Foreign exchange risk from international operations and transactions in multiple currencies
Operating business risk from internal and external factors
Raw material supply and pricing risks due to geopolitical tensions and global supply chain disruptions
Rapid technological advancements requiring continuous investment in product innovation
Supply chain disruptions, geopolitical issues, or delays in procurement of critical raw materials
Changes in government regulations and compliance requirements
facts.related_party_note: Prior to Scheme of Arrangement effective March 31, 2026, company was wholly owned subsidiary of Prima Plastics Limited. Rotational moulding business demerged from Prima Plastics Limited into the company with effect from July 01, 2024 (Appointed Date).
